title: Bootstrap subscriptions remain independent of slow relay publications
observed_behavior: RelayPool held each managed relay mutex while waiting for relay publication network I/O.
Active subscription registration reused the topology mutex held for the duration of PublishWithResults.
A startup burst of payments/history publications could therefore prevent Bootstrapper live-catchup subscriptions from being established before their bounded catch-up timer began.
Production readiness remained in live_catchup until the rollout context was cancelled.
intended_behavior: Relay topology remains stable for the duration of an in-flight publication.
Managed relay state locks are not held across publication network I/O.
Active subscription bookkeeping does not contend on the topology mutex.
Bootstrap can establish bounded live-catchup subscriptions while unrelated relay publications are slow or stalled.
